items.title: PowerPoint: Present with ease using a modernized Presenter View
items.description: When you present with Presenter View, finding the right tool or slide shouldn't break your flow. Presenter View in PowerPoint for Windows has a refreshed design: presenter tools, slide navigation, and the timer now sit together in one control bar, and a new slide thumbnail strip lets you see what's coming and jump to any slide. You can also collapse or resize panes to focus on what matters most as you present.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Introducing IRM Alert classification
items.description: Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Streamline pickup order workflows in Store Commerce
items.description:
Business Value
Trade counter pickups should be fast. When a business customer arrives to collect prepaid or pre-authorized orders, routing them through unnecessary screens and payment steps slows down the process. When customers want to add extra items during pickup, requiring a separate transaction introduces friction that can result in missed sales.
This feature reshapes the pickup experience to better align with trade counter operations. Associates can collect multiple orders in a single acti

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Create pricing rules for attribute-based and volume-based pricing
items.description:
This feature will enable admins to define relevant pricing rules based on the following:
for the added list price based on product attributes
Discount on the list price based on tiered and absolute volume adjustment
This ensures the organization to associate the right pricing and discount policies  to ensure profitability on their offered products and services.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Create product rules to guide sellers to valid product configurations
items.description: This feature will allow admins to create the right set of compatibility, inclusion and exclusion rules, withing a single composite product to ensure the right set of products get bundled together. Based on the configured rules, the seller will receive relevant guidance while configuring a composite product for the customer to ensure an accurate product offering is provided to the customer. The scop of the rules will be at a single quote line relevant to a composite product.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Conversation Analytics
items.description:
Conversation analytics updates are coming to Microsoft Viva Engage, giving communicators richer signals to understand how audiences engage with posts and announcements.
With this update, conversation analytics will include new engagement insights such as click-through rate, open rate, dwell time, and video performance signals. These enhancements help communicators better understand whether employees opened a conversation, spent time with the content, clicked through to linked resources, or engag

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent - Meeting scheduling
items.description: Sales Development Agent can turn a prospect’s interest in meeting into a booked seller meeting. The agent asks the prospect to provide preferred dates and times, evaluates those options against the appropriate seller’s calendar, and books the first valid option in the prospect’s stated preference order. The seller and prospect receive the meeting invitation, while the seller receives additional conversation context to support a warm handoff. If scheduling cannot be completed, the agent transfers

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.
Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn

items.title: PowerPoint: Present with confidence on a single screen in Slide Show
items.description: When you present in Slide Show on just one display, like a laptop with no second monitor and no Presenter View, the on-screen presenting controls can be easy to miss. PowerPoint is making single-screen presenting easier: the controls you need to move through your slides and stay in command are more discoverable and useful, helping you present smoothly and confidently without a second screen.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: View files and conversations side by side
items.description: Review shared files without losing conversation context. When you open a PDF, Markdown, or HTML file from a Teams chat or channel message, the conversation appears alongside the file and takes you directly to where it was shared, allowing you to catch up on the discussion and respond without closing the file preview or switching back to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs being deprecated.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation sna

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Badges in Profile Card in Teams
items.description: You can now see Awards and Certifications as badges on a user’s profile card, bringing a more consistent experience across Teams and Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
items.description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Adaptive Protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management
items.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for GCC-H and DoD environments
items.description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government CCC-H and DoD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Standard and Basic licensed Teams rooms on Windows in the Pro Management portal
items.description: The Teams Rooms Pro Management portal now supports and enforces licenses for devices in Teams Rooms on Windows with a Standard or Basic license. IT admins get a unified device management experience through the Pro Management portal where they can manage those devices with the same functionality found in Teams admin center for that license type.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Alert improvements
items.description: This feature is about improving the alerting capabilities and customization in Communication Compliance.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Automatic data preservation for high-risk users
items.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
items.description: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.
